meta.name: The Hunting Wives
meta.description: Sophie trades New England for East Texas and falls into a wealthy socialite's magnetic orbit — where a clique of housewives hide deadly secrets.

videos.title: Strange and Unfamiliar Places
videos.overview: New to East Texas, Sophie O'Neil bonds with the alluring Margo Banks, who shows Sophie another side of life.

videos.title: Knockin' Boots
videos.overview: Jed considers a run for governor. Margo aims to protect their privacy as the Hunting Wives navigate behind closed doors. The dead blond woman in the woods is found.

videos.title: Sunrise Tells the Story
videos.overview: Margo has a surprise for Sophie and Callie's jealousy grows, as does Jill's concerns. A chilly discovery is made about the unidentified dead woman.

videos.title: Cheat Day
videos.overview: After a body is discovered in the woods, tensions ignite as Margo and Brad rush to align their stories. Sophie searches for her missing handgun.

videos.title: Not Her First Rodeo
videos.overview: Sophie desperately tries to manage her situation. Jill is determined to protect her son at all costs.

videos.title: Deep in the Heart of Texas
videos.overview: Determined to prove her innocence, Sophie searches for answers. Margo hits the campaign trail. Nina's fondness for Pete grows.

videos.title: Shooting Star
videos.overview: New information in Abby's murder investigation threatens to seal the fate of Sophie and the Hunting Wives. Starr discovers an unbearable truth.

videos.title: Sophie's Choice
videos.overview: With Nina's safe return, Pete's suicide and Abby's killer shot dead, Sophie and Margo rest easy knowing the murder is solved, or so they think.

videos.title: Scared Straight
videos.overview: As a new murder investigation begins, Margo tries to locate her brother — but she's not the only one on the hunt. Sophie works to salvage her marriage.

videos.title: This is the Killer Speaking
videos.overview: Sophie scrambles to cover her tracks, but her attempts to play it cool at a campaign fundraiser get heated when she crosses paths with Margo and Callie.

videos.title: Back in the Saddle
videos.overview: Margo and Jed have different ideas about how to handle a vengeful Zelda. Sophie struggles to move on from the past. Callie wears her heart on her sleeve.

videos.title: Riders on the Storm
videos.overview: A confrontation at the lake house puts Margo in harm's way. Sophie makes a devastating confession that leaves her future up in the air.

videos.title: Sonny Came Home
videos.overview: Brad spirals out of control after taking a twisted trip down memory lane. Nadia digs deeper into Abby's death. Margo splurges on a luxurious gift.

videos.title: Last Dance
videos.overview: A shocking faceoff with Brad leaves Margo leaning on Sophie — and questioning her sense of self. Salazar searches for a suspect in Kyle's murder case.

videos.title: Freak on a Leash
videos.overview: As Jed's ruthless campaign manager consolidates control, Margo is trapped in the role of dutiful wife. Callie and Nadia take aim at Abby's killer.

videos.title: Good Luck, Babe
videos.overview: Justice, betrayal and self-preservation collide as the police close in on their prime suspects and Margo and Sophie plot a high-stakes move.
